title: Embeddings lifecycle gating and traffic shaping for new model rollouts
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: We need a standardized, low-risk process to onboard new embedding models and model versions into the embeddings + rerank endpoints. Current ad-hoc rollouts have caused index drift, sudden relevance regressions, and spikes in p99 latency for customers using large-scale stores. Scope: define gating criteria, implement traffic-shaping primitives (canary percentages, per-customer staging), create compatibility shims for dimension/normalization mismatches, and automations for reindexing or fallbacks. Out of scope: retraining downstream models that use embeddings; those will be handled by downstream owners after we publish compatibility guarantees.
background: We currently operate several embedding variants (e.g., Redwood-embed-1-small, rwd-embed-2-fp16) with different dims and quant profiles. Recent onboarding attempts surfaced three pain points: 1) customers' vector stores break silently when dims change; 2) relevance regressions are visible only after weeks and are hard to attribute; 3) large-scale reindexes are operationally heavy and impact throughput. This ticket codifies rollout policy + infra changes to avoid those failures.
acceptance_criteria: Canary traffic primitive implemented: traffic can be split by percent and by customer segment (ID list).
Compatibility shim for dimension/normalization mismatches that either auto-transforms vectors or rejects with clear error and migration steps.
Automated canary schedule: initial 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with configurable pause windows and rollback triggers.
Monitoring dashboards show key metrics for canaries (MRR@10, cosine drift, recall@K, embed_gen_latency_p50/p99) and alert rules for regression thresholds.
Runbook entries and a dry-run reindex tool that can perform blue-green index swaps with minimal query disruption.
Documentation for PMs and SREs with required checklist items for deprecation (90/60/30 day notices) and forced-sunset path.
Automated test harness that runs our eval set against new model variants and produces a pass/fail signal before canary promotion.
proposed_solution: 1) Infra: add a traffic-shaper layer in embeddings router that supports percent-based canaries and customer allowlists. 2) API/SDK: introduce 'embedding_version' field and 'compatibility': { 'dim': n, 'norm': 'l2' } metadata in model catalog. 3) Compatibility shims: when dim matches -> pass-through; when dim differs by small delta -> runtime projection/zero-pad with explicit warning; when incompatible -> reject+migration guidance. 4) Reindex tooling: provide an incremental reindexer that can materialize a new index in parallel and perform a blue-green swap with TTL based warm-up. 5) Observability: add canary dashboards and automated eval runner that computes MRR/recall/cosine-drift. 6) Rollout automation: state-machine that advances percentage on time-window and metric pass. 7) Policy: deprecation windows (90/60/30) and defined hard-sunset triggers. Implementation will be split into infra (router + indexer), runtime (compat shim), and automation (state-machine + eval runner).
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Playground/Sandbox: allow customers to opt-in to 'staging' model versions with no production traffic (docs + sample vector store).
Phase 1 - Micro-canary: 1% internal customer traffic + internal eval run for 72h. Generate MRR + latency baselines.
Phase 2 - Customer canary: 5% traffic to selected customer allowlist for 7d, monitor for regressions and infra scaling impact.
Phase 3 - Ramp: 25% for 48h, then 100% if no alerts. Keep auto-rollback windows after each step.
Phase 4 - Post-promote: schedule background reindex jobs for large stores with progress tracking and blue-green swap when ready.
Rollback criteria: MRR@10 drop >5% relative to baseline OR cosine similarity drift above configured threshold OR p99 latency increase >20%.
Deprecation timeline for old versions: 90-day notice, voluntary migration tools at 60 days, forced sunset after 90 days unless exception.
monitoring_and_mitigation: Alerts: automatic paging on regression detection and sustained p99 latency increases for >30m.
Mitigation: automatic traffic rollback, switch to fallback model variant (lower-dim or previous stable), and prioritized background reindexing.
Auditing: log model_version per request and provide retroactive changelogs for debug.
Customer-facing: created template emails and Console banners to warn customers of upcoming deprecations and allow early opt-outs.

Indexer: build incremental reindex + blue-green swap tool with progress reporting (ENG-25432.5)
Dashboards/alerts: create canary dashboards and SLO-based alerts (ENG-25432.6)

notes: Edge cases: when customers store mixed-dimension indexes we will require index-level metadata and refuse mixed-dim swaps unless migration path is used. We must also be explicit about numeric stability when changing quantization (e.g., int8 -> fp16).
